title: Implement Option 3: Marigold & Terracotta (Warm Cottage) Accent Theme
description: Implemented Option 3: Marigold & Terracotta (Warm Cottage) across the entire website via the robust variable system established in app/globals.css. Configured semantic tokens --color-accent (#E05F3E - Terracotta), --color-accent-hover (#C74828 - Deep Terracotta), --color-accent-secondary (#FFBC42 - Marigold), --color-accent-light (#FFF3E0 light, rgba(224, 95, 62, 0.18) dark), --color-accent-tint (rgba(224, 95, 62, 0.06) light, rgba(224, 95, 62, 0.08) dark), and --color-accent-contrast (#FFFFFF) across :root, .dark, and .light. Verified legacy aliases and inline theme bindings cascade immediately to buttons, indicators, and active states across Header, Footer, Cart, RFQ Portal, Category Pills, and Services. Authored tests/task-36-marigold-terracotta-theme.spec.ts (7/7 passing), verified Next.js production build (19/19 routes), and captured 9 visual proof screenshots in .agent/screenshots/ and synced to parent brain directory.
acceptanceCriteria: Design tokens in app/globals.css define --color-accent: #E05F3E, --color-accent-hover: #C74828, --color-accent-secondary: #FFBC42, --color-accent-contrast: #FFFFFF across :root, .dark, and .light
--color-accent-light is set to #FFF3E0 in Light Mode and rgba(224, 95, 62, 0.18) in Dark Mode
--color-accent-tint is set to rgba(224, 95, 62, 0.06) in Light Mode and rgba(224, 95, 62, 0.08) in Dark Mode

Mobile responsiveness (390x844) verified with zero horizontal overflow
Zero TypeScript and build errors on npm run build across all 19 routes
